char0.name: Zahar
char0.description2: A storyteller with a voice like rumbling stones.
char0.description3: His hands are gnarled but still skilled at carving antler.
char0.description4: He remembers the 'long winter' after the sky went dark.
char0.description5: He has a deep knowledge of the spirits and rituals.
char0.description6: His eyesight is failing, but he sees more than most.
char0.description7: He is the grandfather of Kemen and Sua.
char0.description8: He often sits by the fire, observing everything.
char0.description9: He carries the history of the band in his memory.

char1.name: Aitor
char1.description2: He has a prominent scar over his left eye.
char1.description3: He is quiet and observant, rarely speaking without reason.
char1.description4: He is the mate of Lurra.
char1.description5: He is an expert tracker, able to read the faintest signs.
char1.description6: He carries a spear tipped with a finely worked flint point.
char1.description7: He is patient and methodical in all his actions.
char1.description8: He is respected for his ability to provide for the group.
char1.description9: He feels the weight of responsibility for the hunt's success.

char2.name: Lurra
char2.description1: Her hands are often stained with ochre.
char2.description2: She is a skilled hide-worker and artisan.
char2.description3: She is the mate of Aitor and mother of Sua.
char2.description4: She has a calm and reassuring presence.
char2.description5: She knows the best methods for tanning and softening skins.
char2.description6: She creates the pigments used for painting.
char2.description7: She often hums quietly while she works.
char2.description8: She is teaching the older children how to sew with bone needles.
char2.description9: She believes beauty is as important as utility.

char3.name: Bor
char3.description3: He is strong but can be reckless.
char3.description4: He is the mate of Amaia.
char3.description5: He excels at the final charge of a hunt.
char3.description6: He often boasts of his strength by the fire.
char3.description7: He is fiercely protective of his family.
char3.description8: He has a friendly rivalry with Aitor.
char3.description9: He fears the quiet of the deep caves.

char4.name: Amaia
char4.description2: She has a deep knowledge of plants and herbs.
char4.description3: She is the mate of Bor and mother of Gorka.
char4.description4: She moves with a quiet grace through the landscape.
char4.description5: She knows which roots are for food and which are for medicine.
char4.description6: She is often found near the river, gathering reeds for baskets.
char4.description7: She is shy and speaks softly.
char4.description8: She is the one who tends to injuries and illnesses.
char4.description9: She feels a deep connection to the earth and its cycles.

char5.name: Kemen
char5.description3: He is Zahar's grandson and Sua's older brother.
char5.description4: He is eager to prove his worth on the hunt.
char5.description5: He is an excellent shot with the atlatl.
char5.description6: He often listens to the elders' stories with great intensity.
char5.description7: He is thoughtful and often seems lost in thought.
char5.description8: He feels the shadow of Aitor's reputation.
char5.description9: He dreams of hunting the great bison.

char6.name: Sua
char6.description1: Her hair is the color of fire.
char6.description3: She is the daughter of Aitor and Lurra.
char6.description4: She loves to play games with smooth stones.
char6.description5: She follows her mother everywhere, learning her skills.
char6.description6: She is not afraid of spiders or snakes.
char6.description7: She has a bright, infectious laugh.
char6.description8: She looks up to her older brother, Kemen.
char6.description9: She is just beginning to understand the world of spirits.

char7.name: Gorka
char7.description1: He is mischievous and always dirty.
char7.description3: He is the son of Bor and Amaia.
char7.description4: He is often found hiding or playing tricks.
char7.description5: He tries to follow the hunters when they leave.
char7.description6: He is loud and energetic, like his father.
char7.description7: He has a collection of interesting rocks and bones.
char7.description8: He is wary of the elders' serious talks.
char7.description9: He sees the world as a playground.

char8.name: Ines
char8.description1: An elder with sharp, intelligent eyes.
char8.description2: She is the matriarch of another family.
char8.description3: She is a keeper of genealogies and relationships.
char8.description4: Her advice is sought for disputes within the group.
char8.description5: She is a master weaver of baskets and nets.
char8.description6: She has a dry wit and a sharp tongue.
char8.description7: She lost her mate many winters ago.
char8.description8: She ensures the children learn the rules of kinship.
char8.description9: She believes order is what keeps the band alive.

char9.name: Unai
char9.description2: His hands are calloused and strong.
char9.description4: He can produce a perfect blade in minutes.
char9.description5: He is responsible for quarrying the best flint.
char9.description6: He is a man of few words, preferring to let his work speak.
char9.description7: He is patient and has an eye for detail.
char9.description8: He feels a deep satisfaction in creating a perfect tool.
char9.description9: He is the quiet engine of the band's survival.

char10.name: Nerea
char10.description0: A woman with a strong build.
char10.description2: Her arms are strong from casting nets.
char10.description3: She is the mate of Unai.
char10.description4: She knows the tides and the best spots for shellfish.
char10.description6: She is often seen returning from the shoreline, her basket full.
char10.description7: She has a loud, clear voice.
char10.description8: She is teaching her daughter, Elira, to fish.
char10.description9: She finds peace in the rhythm of the sea.

char11.name: Harkaitz
char11.description2: He is often on watch at the edge of the camp.
char11.description3: He is Ines's second son and mate of Ederra.
char11.description4: He is vigilant and has excellent hearing.
char11.description5: He is not as skilled a tracker as Aitor, but he is tireless.
char11.description6: He is a protector, always aware of potential dangers.
char11.description8: He is a man of few words.
char11.description9: He feels most alive when facing a storm or a predator.

char12.name: Elira
char12.description1: She is learning to be a woman.
char12.description2: She is the daughter of Unai and Nerea.
char12.description3: She is skilled at mending nets and weaving.
char12.description4: She is often seen with the other young women, gossiping.
char12.description5: She is curious about the world beyond the valley.
char12.description6: She has a talent for making jewelry from shells.
char12.description7: She is beginning to attract the attention of the young men.
char12.description8: She is both excited and nervous about her future.
char12.description9: She wonders what her life's purpose will be.

char13.name: Oihan
char13.description1: He is trying to become a hunter.
char13.description2: He is the son of Unai and Nerea.
char13.description3: He is strong but lacks Kemen's focus.
char13.description4: He is often found practicing with a throwing spear.
char13.description5: He is friends with Gorka, and they often get into trouble.
char13.description6: He is impatient and eager for action.
char13.description7: He wants to earn the respect of the older hunters.
char13.description9: He feels the pressure to live up to his family's reputation.

char14.name: Maialen
char14.description1: She is often tired but content.
char14.description2: She is the mate of a hunter named Eneko.
char14.description3: She spends most of her time nursing her baby, Ekain.
char14.description4: She is part of Lurra and Amaia's circle of women.
char14.description5: She is a skilled forager, though she cannot range far now.
char14.description6: She is focused entirely on the survival of her child.
char14.description7: She often seeks advice from the older women.
char14.description8: She represents the future of the band.
char14.description9: She feels a fierce, primal love for her infant.

char15.name: Eneko
char15.description2: He is the new father of Ekain.
char15.description3: He is the mate of Maialen.
char15.description4: He hunts with a renewed sense of purpose.
char15.description5: He is an expert at trapping smaller game like hares.
char15.description6: He is quieter now, more serious since the baby was born.
char15.description7: He often brings back special stones or feathers for the child.
char15.description8: He works hard to provide for his new family.
char15.description9: He is filled with a new kind of pride.

char16.name: Pello
char16.description0: An old man with a limp.
char16.description2: He was once a great hunter.
char16.description3: Aurochs gored his leg many years ago.
char16.description4: He now teaches the boys how to make and repair tools.
char16.description5: He has a vast knowledge of animal behavior.
char16.description6: He is sometimes grumpy but has a kind heart.
char16.description7: He is the one who maintains the supply of spear shafts.
char16.description8: He is the father of Maddi.
char16.description9: He finds new purpose in passing on his knowledge.

char17.name: Irati
char17.description0: A woman with long, dark hair.
char17.description3: She is known for her sharp eyes and quick hands.
char17.description4: She can find berries and roots where others see nothing.
char17.description5: She is independent and prefers to work alone.
char17.description7: She knows the territory as well as any hunter.
char17.description8: Some say she has a special connection to the forest.
char17.description9: She values her freedom above all else.

char18.name: Ibai
char18.description0: A man with a thoughtful expression.
char18.description2: He is not a primary hunter.
char18.description3: He is responsible for many of the engravings on tools and bones.
char18.description4: He works closely with Zahar, learning the old patterns.
char18.description5: He is the mate of Alaia and father of Odei.
char18.description7: He sees the world in lines and shapes.
char18.description8: He believes his work honors the spirits of the animals.
char18.description9: He is the memory-keeper of the band, in physical form.

char19.name: Alaia
char19.description3: She is the mate of Ibai and mother of Odei.
char19.description4: She is an expert at finding bird eggs and edible insects.
char19.description5: She brings a sense of lightness and joy to the group.
char19.description6: She is often heard singing as she works.
char19.description7: She is very sociable and loves to gossip.
char19.description8: She helps to ease tensions within the band.
char19.description9: She believes in finding happiness in the small things.

char20.name: Mikel
char20.description3: He is the mate of Itxaso.
char20.description4: He is the father of Haizea and Santi.
char20.description5: He is a steady presence in the hunting party.
char20.description6: He is not a leader, but a vital follower.
char20.description7: He is deeply loyal to Aitor.
char20.description8: He enjoys the physical exertion of the hunt.
char20.description9: He is the quiet backbone of the hunting group.

char21.name: Leire
char21.description0: A woman with a stern face.
char21.description3: Her mate was lost in a hunting accident.
char21.description4: She is now fiercely independent and self-reliant.
char21.description5: She is an expert at making tough, durable clothing.
char21.description6: She does not suffer fools gladly.
char21.description7: She is respected, but also a little feared.
char21.description8: She is raising her son, Iker, to be strong.
char21.description9: She carries a deep sadness that she never shows.

char22.name: Iker
char22.description2: He is growing up without a father.
char22.description3: He is more serious than the other boys his age.
char22.description4: He is learning to knap flint from Unai.
char22.description5: He feels a great responsibility to care for his mother.
char22.description7: He wants to become a hunter to honor his father's memory.
char22.description8: He carries the burden of his mother's grief.
char22.description9: He is determined to become a man of great skill.

char23.name: Haizea
char23.description0: A girl with wild, windswept hair.
char23.description1: A child of about ten winters.
char23.description3: She is the daughter of Mikel and Itxaso.
char23.description4: She often wanders further from the camp than she should.
char23.description7: She is not interested in learning to sew or weave.
char23.description8: She wants to see what's on the other side of the mountains.
char23.description9: She has a spirit that cannot be tamed.

char24.name: Ander
char24.description0: A young man with a slight build.
char24.description2: He has a gift for music.
char24.description3: He can make a flute from a bird bone that sings.
char24.description4: He often plays music by the fire in the evenings.
char24.description6: He is also skilled at making fishing hooks from bone.
char24.description7: He is close friends with Ibai, the artist.
char24.description8: His music can soothe babies and calm arguments.
char24.description9: He brings a different kind of value to the band.

char25.name: Itxaso
char25.description0: A woman who smells of the sea.
char25.description2: She is Nerea's younger sister and mate of Mikel.
char25.description4: She is not afraid to venture into the cold water.
char25.description5: She is the mother of Nahia, Haizea, and Santi.
char25.description6: She is loud and laughs from her belly.
char25.description7: She has a competitive streak with her sister.
char25.description8: She is a vital provider of food.
char25.description9: She feels the power of the ocean in her blood.

char26.name: Xabier
char26.description0: A man who is always tinkering.
char26.description2: He is not a hunter, but supports them.
char26.description3: He is an expert at hafting spear points and axe heads.
char26.description4: He is always experimenting with new kinds of resin and sinew.
char26.description6: He is responsible for the repair of most tools.
char26.description7: He is a quiet but essential part of the hunting process.
char26.description8: He takes great pride in the durability of his work.
char26.description9: He understands the mechanics of how things work.

char27.name: Maddi
char27.description1: She has just come of age.
char27.description2: She is the daughter of Pello.
char27.description4: She is learning the skills of a woman from Lurra and Amaia.
char27.description5: She is a little overwhelmed by her new status.
char27.description7: She is being courted by Oihan.
char27.description8: She is at the threshold of a new life.
char27.description9: She is trying to find her place in the world of adults.

char28.name: Odei
char28.description1: A boy with big, round eyes.
char28.description2: He is the son of Alaia and Ibai.
char28.description3: He is quiet and watchful, like his father.
char28.description4: He loves to watch his father carve.
char28.description5: He is often found playing by himself.
char28.description6: He is fascinated by the shapes of clouds.
char28.description7: He is a gentle and sensitive child.
char28.description8: He is just beginning to learn the names of the animals.
char28.description9: He sees the world with an artist's eye.

char29.name: Nahia
char29.description2: She is the daughter of Itxaso.
char29.description3: She is always at Zahar's feet when he speaks.
char29.description5: She is beginning to learn the simpler foraging tasks.
char29.description7: She is close friends with Sua.
char29.description8: She believes everything the storytellers say is true.
char29.description9: She lives half in this world, and half in the world of myths.

char30.name: Gizon
char30.description0: A man who came from another band.
char30.description2: He joined the group a few years ago.
char30.description3: He married a woman who has since died.
char30.description4: He is still seen as something of an outsider.
char30.description5: He has different ways of doing things.
char30.description6: He is a skilled hunter but does not boast.
char30.description7: He is solitary and keeps his own counsel.
char30.description8: He carries the memory of his former life with him.
char30.description9: He is searching for a new sense of belonging.

char31.name: Santi
char31.description2: He is strong for his age.
char31.description3: He is the son of Mikel and Itxaso.
char31.description4: He is eager to join his first real hunt.
char31.description5: He is learning to read tracks from Aitor.
char31.description6: He is full of nervous energy.
char31.description7: He looks up to Kemen as a role model.
char31.description8: He is on the cusp of manhood.
char31.description9: He feels the pull of both childhood and adulthood.

char32.name: Ederra
char32.description0: A woman known for her beauty.
char32.description2: She is aware of the effect she has on men.
char32.description3: She is the mate of Harkaitz, the guard.
char32.description4: She is skilled at making decorative items.
char32.description5: She can be vain and a little lazy.
char32.description6: She enjoys the attention she receives.
char32.description7: She is a source of some gossip and jealousy.
char32.description8: She relies on her looks more than her skills.
char32.description9: She desires a life of ease.

char33.name: Txiki
char33.description2: He is just learning to speak in full sentences.
char33.description3: He is the son of Iñigo and Argi.
char33.description5: He is doted on by the older children.
char33.description8: His world is the space immediately around the hearth.

char34.name: Lizar
char34.description0: A man with a weathered face.
char34.description2: He spends most of his time by the river.
char34.description4: He knows the best spots for trout and salmon.
char34.description5: He uses both nets and spears.
char34.description6: He is a quiet observer of nature.
char34.description7: He provides a steady, if not large, supply of food.
char34.description8: He is at peace when he is near the water.
char34.description9: He understands the language of the river.

char35.name: Goizane
char35.description0: A woman who wakes before the sun.
char35.description2: She is responsible for keeping the main fire.
char35.description4: She ensures the fire never dies out completely.
char35.description5: She is the first one awake and the last to sleep.
char35.description6: She is a creature of habit and ritual.
char35.description7: She knows the old songs and chants.
char35.description8: She is the quiet, steady heart of the camp.
char35.description9: She believes the fire is the spirit of the band.

char36.name: Patxi
char36.description0: A boy with a knack for trouble.
char36.description2: He is the son of Orkatz and Bihotz.
char36.description3: He is always daring others to do reckless things.
char36.description4: He is full of boundless energy.
char36.description5: He is often being scolded by his mother.
char36.description7: He is the leader of the younger children's games.
char36.description8: He is learning to be a boy in a world of hunters.
char36.description9: He is a spark of chaos in the ordered camp.

char37.name: Zuri
char37.description0: A girl with very pale skin.
char37.description2: She is the daughter of Orkatz and Bihotz.
char37.description4: She is often found on the edge of the group.
char37.description5: She helps her mother with scraping hides.
char37.description6: She has a rich inner world.
char37.description8: She notices things that others miss.
char37.description9: She is learning to navigate the social world.

char38.name: Orkatz
char38.description0: A man in his late prime.
char38.description2: He is beginning to slow down.
char38.description3: He is the mate of Bihotz.
char38.description4: He is a solid, if unspectacular, provider.
char38.description5: He is a good teacher to the younger boys.
char38.description6: He is the father of Patxi and Zuri.
char38.description7: He has a calm and steady temperament.
char38.description8: He is content with his place in the group.
char38.description9: He represents the solid core of the band.

char39.name: Bihotz
char39.description0: A woman with a kind face.
char39.description2: She is the mate of Orkatz.
char39.description3: She is known for her generosity.
char39.description4: She is the mother of Patxi and Zuri.
char39.description5: She is a central figure in the women's social network.
char39.description7: She is deeply loved by her family.
char39.description8: She is the emotional glue for her family.
char39.description9: She finds her purpose in caring for others.

char40.name: Ekain
char40.description1: He is barely a moon old.
char40.description2: He is the son of Maialen and Eneko.
char40.description3: He is either sleeping or nursing.
char40.description4: He is wrapped tightly in soft rabbit furs.
char40.description5: His world is warmth, milk, and his mother's heartbeat.
char40.description6: He is the newest member of the band.
char40.description7: He is a symbol of the future.
char40.description8: He is utterly dependent and vulnerable.
char40.description9: He is a tiny vessel of immense hope.

char41.name: Iñigo
char41.description2: He is the mate of Argi.
char41.description3: He is the father of Txiki.
char41.description4: He is still learning the ways of the hunt.
char41.description5: He is often tasked with carrying supplies.
char41.description7: He feels the new weight of providing for a family.
char41.description8: He is a little overwhelmed but proud.
char41.description9: He is at the beginning of his life as a man.

char42.name: Argi
char42.description2: She is the mate of Iñigo.
char42.description3: She is the mother of Txiki.
char42.description4: She is learning how to be a mother from the other women.
char42.description5: She is often seen with Maialen, sharing advice.
char42.description6: She is a skilled gatherer of firewood.
char42.description8: Her world has become small, but infinitely precious.
char42.description9: She is discovering a strength she didn't know she had.
